definitions: To produce or send out (e.g., leaves, buds, an effort).
To propose or present (e.g., an idea, a theory, a candidate).
To exert or apply (e.g., strength, effort).
examples: The tree will put forth new leaves in spring.
She put forth a compelling argument.
He had to put forth a lot of effort to finish the race.
pastTenses: put forth (past simple), put forth (past perfect)
